work.author: Clemens PP. XIV.
work.description: Act IX is independently complete. Its confirmation commission reports the concordia and directs the future decree to insert its tenor; it does not claim to print that separate concordia as an annex. Exact ranges retain all own marginal summaries/date and final datum, exclude running furniture and displaced marginal matter belonging to following X at LF10700–10722. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
